questions.stem: How does auxin cause a shoot to bend towards light?

options.text: Auxin moves to the sunny side and makes cells grow faster there
Auxin moves to the shaded side, causing cells there to elongate more, bending the shoot towards light
Light destroys auxin on the sunny side, making the shoot lighter on that side
Auxin causes cells on the lit side to shrink

questions.explanation: When light hits a shoot from one side, auxin migrates to the shaded side. The higher auxin concentration causes cells on the shaded side to elongate more, bending the shoot towards the light.
